leadText:
Pikachu Shocks Back issue 3 is the seventh monthly issue of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the seventh chapter of the manga, Pikachu's Excellent Adventure. 

The contents of this issue were included as part of along with ET05, ET06, and ET08.
